sentences.text: Egertonodus is a member of the family Hybodontidae, which falls within the class Chondrichthyes, the group containing cartilaginous fish.
This genus is distinguished from the closely related Hybodus sensu stricto by specific characters of the skull and teeth.
The most common species, E. basanus, is thought to have reached a length of 1.5 meters.
The genus lived between 168.2 and 83.6 million years ago, spanning from the Bathonian to the Santonian.
It is debated whether E. fraasi belongs in Egertonodus, as some authors question the placement due to strong differences in tooth morphology.
